newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends flat at 485.50/486.75/dlr.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends flat at 485.50/486.75/dlr.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed flat at 485.50/486.75 per dollar in quiet trade after the Central Bank supplied the market with the dollars it needed, brokers said.
"It was a tranquil day, dollar demand was regular and the Central Bank sold dollars as they were required," said one trader at a mid-sized bank.

Venezuela's foreign exchange market is unusual in that the Central Bank is its largest single supplier of dollars, which blurs the difference between the Central Bank supplying liquidity and intervening.
